content: Web consensus: notifications use fan-out-on-write (one row per recipient) for fast reads and simple unread counts (read_at nullable + index on recipient, read_at); lazy/read-time generation only for huge audiences. Fan-out should run via a queue worker, not inline in the request; preferences and device/push tokens live in Postgres; unread count via count where read_at is null or a denormalized counter.
